title: Implement feature 4
last_note: patch at /workspace/shared/agent2.patch (4 source files, no tests). get() semantics: hit = key found in memory or disk layer (membership test, not value truthiness, so a falsy cached value still counts as a hit); mem hit bumps hits+mem_hits, disk hit bumps hits+disk_hits (then promoted to memory), a lookup that finds nothing bumps misses; a cache_key failure returns None early and counts nothing. Counters are updated by Cache._record_cache_event under self._lock, which also feeds the per-call tracker found via settings.get('cache_usage_tracker'). stats() always returns all 4 keys as a plain dict copy.
